documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Intimation
Shareholder Meeting / Postal Ballot-Outcome of AGM

analysis.summary: Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported a 53.3% YoY increase in revenue from operations to ₹ 472.2 crores for Q1 FY27, with PAT rising 42.9% YoY to ₹ 65.6 crores. The company is executing a ~₹ 200 crore capacity expansion from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA, targeted for commissioning by September 2026. This expansion is fully funded through internal accruals, and optimal utilization is expected by the end of FY28. Bhansali Engineering Polymers Limited reported a revenue of INR 1,276.0 crores for FY26 along with an EBITDA of INR 255.2 crores and PAT of INR 180.2 crores. Management highlighted an ongoing capacity expansion from 75,000 MTPA to 100,000 MTPA backed by a ₹200 crore capex funded through internal accruals, with commissioning targeted by September 2026.

guidance.claim: The company expects to achieve optimal utilization of its expanded capacity by the end of FY28.
guidance.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

demand_outlook.claim: Domestic demand for ABS will be driven by robust growth in end-user industries such as automotive and consumer durables.
demand_outlook.quote: Robust growth in end-user industries like consumer durables (air conditioners, refrigerators) and automotive will drive the domestic demand for ABS.

demand_outlook.claim: The global market is transitioning toward specialty and colored grades instead of commoditized transparent resins.
demand_outlook.quote: The global market is shifting toward specialty & colored grades, moving away from commoditized transparent resins to higher-margin applications.

demand_outlook.claim: EV adoption is accelerating the consumption of high-performance plastics for interior trims and battery housings.
demand_outlook.quote: EV (Electric Vehicle) adoption is accelerating consumption as manufacturers prioritize lightweight, high-performance plastics for interior trims and battery housings.

demand_outlook.claim: There is significant growth potential due to a supply-demand mismatch where India's ABS consumption exceeds domestic production.
demand_outlook.quote: There is immense scope for growth, considering the existing supply and demand mismatch, and knowing the fact that the consumption of ABS in India is voluminously larger as compared to the combined output of the domestic manufacturers.

demand_outlook.claim: The Indian household appliances market is projected to grow steadily, driven by rising penetration, replacement demand, and retail expansion.
demand_outlook.quote: The major home appliances market in India was estimated at approximately `1.86 lakh crore in 2025 and is projected to grow steadily over the coming years, supported by increasing household penetration, replacement demand and the expansion of organised retail and e-commerce channels.

demand_outlook.claim: The adoption of premium, smart, and energy-efficient appliances is driving demand for high-performance engineering plastics.
demand_outlook.quote: The increasing adoption of premium appliances, smart home solutions and energy-efficient products is driving demand for high-performance engineering plastics.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is progressing with its capacity expansion from 75,000 TPA to 1,00,000 TPA and has ordered critical long-delivery equipment.
capex_expansion.quote: The implementation of capacity expansion from existing 75000 TPA to 1,00,000 TPA is progressing well and orders have been placed for critical long delivery equipments.

capex_expansion.claim: Commissioning of the enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by the end of September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for Q1 FY27 increased by 44.5% YoY to ₹ 92.3 crores, with margins at 19.2%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 44.5% YoY in Q1 FY27 to ₹ 92.3 crores, from ₹ 63.9 crores in Q1 FY26, with margins at 19.2% for Q1 FY27 as compared to 20.0% in Q1 FY26.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA for FY26 grew by 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores with margins at 20.0%.
margins_costs.quote: for FY26, EBITDA grew by 1.3% to INR 255.2 crores, with margins at 20.0%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA increased by 33.1% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 74.3 crores with margins at 21.8%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA increased by 33.1% YoY in Q4 FY26 to INR 74.3 crores, with margins at 21.8%;

margins_costs.claim: The company's operating margin rose to 19.42% and net profit margin reached 14.14% in FY 2025-26.
margins_costs.quote: The operating margin for FY 2025-26 was 19.42 % as compared to 17.43 % for FY 2024-25, whereas the net profit margin stood at 14.14 % as compared to 12.86 % for the previous FY.

orders_capacity.claim: The company achieved a production volume of 71,601.50 TPA against an installed capacity of 75,000 TPA in FY 2025-26.
orders_capacity.quote: During FY 2025-26, the Company achieved a production volume of 71,601.50 TPA against installed capacity of 75,000 TPA.

orders_capacity.claim: Sales volume for the year stood at 71,501.12 TPA.
orders_capacity.quote: Sales volume for the year stood at 71,501.12 TPA as compared to 74,381 TPA in FY 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has a debt-free balance sheet with zero financial risk.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt-free balance sheet ensures zero financial risk and high resilience.

capital_allocation.claim: Consistent positive operating cash flows support self-funded growth.
capital_allocation.quote: Consistent positive operating cash flows (CFO) support self-funded growth without reliance on external capital.

capital_allocation.claim: A healthy dividend payout of over 50% reflects disciplined capital allocation.
capital_allocation.quote: Healthy dividend payout (~50%+)* reflects disciplined capital allocation and shareholder returns.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to operate with zero debt.
capital_allocation.quote: The Company continues to enjoy the status of a “Zero Debt Company”.

capital_allocation.claim: The company expects to sustain its business operations through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: There was no change in financing pattern and the Company would be able to sustain its business operations through internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: The board declared three interim dividends of Re. 1 each and recommended a final dividend of Re. 1 per share for FY 2025-26.
capital_allocation.quote: Continuing with the practice of rewarding shareholders, the Board declared three Interim Dividends, each of Re.1/- (collectively 300%) per Equity shares of Re.1/- and recommended a Final Dividend of Re.1/- (100 %) per Equity Share for the Financial Year Ended 31st March, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The directors do not propose to transfer any amount to the General Reserve for the fiscal year ended March 31, 2026.
capital_allocation.quote: For the FY ended 31st March, 2026, the Directors do not propose to transfer any amount to the General Reserve.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company's presentation contains forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties.
risks_headwinds.quote: This presentation may contain forward-looking statements that involve risks and uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: The ABS business in India faces foreign exchange risks due to its dependence on imported Styrene and Acrylonitrile.
risks_headwinds.quote: The ABS business in India is exposed to the risk of foreign exchange fluctuations, as the key raw materials viz. ‘Styrene’ and ‘Acrylonitrile’ are import dependent, as there is no indigenous producer for these monomers.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global economic outlook has darkened due to the outbreak of war in the Middle East.
risks_headwinds.quote: The global outlook has abruptly darkened following the outbreak of war in the Middle East on February 28, 2026.

risks_headwinds.claim: The closure of the Strait of Hormuz and damage to production facilities could trigger an unprecedented energy crisis.
risks_headwinds.quote: The closure of the Strait of Hormuz and serious damage to critical production facilities in a region central to global hydrocarbon supply could cause an energy crisis on an unprecedented scale.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve optimal utilization of its expanded capacity by the end of FY28.
management_commitments.quote: Optimal utilisation of expanded capacity expected by end of FY28.

management_commitments.claim: The commissioning of the enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by the end of September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: The balance engineering, procurement and construction work is in progress and the commissioning of enhanced capacity is expected to be completed by end of September, 2026.
